name: new-tools
description: PDF editor (pdf-editor) and the Toolyverse website that embeds it (toolyverse).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix pdf-editor install && npm --prefix toolyverse install
scripts.site: npm --prefix pdf-editor run build:embed && npm --prefix toolyverse run dev
scripts.test: npm --prefix pdf-editor test && npm --prefix toolyverse test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix pdf-editor run typecheck && npm --prefix toolyverse run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix pdf-editor run build:embed && npm --prefix toolyverse run build
